scenes.say: Does your hair go flat by noon? In Korea, root volume starts with how you dry it.
First, dry your roots before the ends, brushing them the opposite way from your part. Finish with a few seconds of cool air.
scenes.label: Step 1

scenes.say: Next, roll a velcro roller at your crown or into your bangs, and leave it for about ten minutes while you do your makeup.
scenes.label: Step 2

scenes.say: Then mist a little volume spray, or tap root powder, at the roots only. Hair oil goes on the ends.
scenes.label: Step 3

scenes.say: The common mistake? Putting conditioner or oil near your scalp. It weighs the roots down by lunch.
scenes.label: Common mistake

scenes.say: Do you use rollers? Tell me in the comments. The shopping link is in my profile.
